episode_title: Scaling Beyond Word-of-Mouth - Dustin Tropp - Marketing Agency Power Hour - Episode #71

real_qa.q: What pricing model does RepublicanJobs.com use instead of the traditional 30% headhunter fee?
real_qa.r: RepublicanJobs.com uses a flat-rate, straight pricing model where clients only pay a fee upon successful placement, charging between one-tenth to one-fifth of traditional headhunter rates. The company operates on a non-exclusive basis, positioning itself as able to find better candidates faster than clients can recruit themselves, with an 88% success rate on placements.

real_qa.q: How many candidates has RepublicanJobs.com placed and how long did it take?
real_qa.r: RepublicanJobs.com has placed over 3,300 candidates in the last four and a half years into roles across the Republican ecosystem. Dustin Tropp has overseen a total placement of about 8,000 people throughout his recruiting career.

real_qa.q: What percentage of RepublicanJobs.com business comes from word-of-mouth referrals?
real_qa.r: About 91% of RepublicanJobs.com's new clients come from word-of-mouth referrals, with the company proactively generating approximately 9% of business through direct outreach and marketing efforts.
real_qa.requete: RepublicanJobs.com word of mouth referral percentage

real_qa.q: What was Dustin Tropp's early pricing mistake before raising rates on RepublicanJobs.com?
real_qa.r: Tropp was severely underbilling in the first year, charging only $200-$300 per placement when he later raised rates to $5,000 per placement. Despite nearly going out of business from underbilling, when he raised rates, not a single client dropped and most thanked him for raising prices.
real_qa.requete: Dustin Tropp pricing mistake RepublicanJobs.com underbilling

real_qa.q: How many resumes does RepublicanJobs.com receive weekly without active job postings?
real_qa.r: RepublicanJobs.com receives approximately 1,000 resumes per week without doing any job postings or outward recruitment efforts. Over the last four and a half years since the company started, it has interviewed about 30,000 people.

real_qa.q: What is the AI adoption rate difference between Republican and Democratic political campaigns?
real_qa.r: According to industry surveys conducted through trade associations including the American Association of Political Consultants (AAPC), Republicans show approximately 90% openness to adopting AI, while Democrats show significantly lower adoption rates in the low 20s range. Republicans have moved ahead on the data and technology side due to greater willingness to use AI tools.
real_qa.requete: Republican Democrat AI adoption rate political campaigns

guest.bio_context: Dustin Tropp is a campaign veteran and published author who wrote his college thesis on how to win local and state office. He worked in various campaigns starting in Texas before identifying a gap in the political jobs market and building RepublicanJobs.com from scratch, where he has placed over 3,300 candidates into roles across the Republican ecosystem. More recently, he founded Capital Jobs to serve the broader government affairs and lobbying space.
